articles.title: NEAR Intents hit by $3.8 million exploit as crypto's rough year of hacks continues
articles.snippet: The popular cross-chain trading system said Friday the exploiter returned all stolen assets a day later a bug affected deposits and withdrawals across several networks.

articles.title: Aave founder says V3 unaffected after third-party adapter exploit drains $305K
articles.snippet: Aave founder Stani Kulechov said Aave v3 was unaffected after an attacker exploited a third-party adapter to drain about $305,000 from two Safe multisig wallets.

articles.title: Zano exploiter minted more than a quadrillion fUSD before blockchain rollback
articles.snippet: The unauthorized coins were indistinguishable from legitimate ZANO, leaving the team unable to remove them without rolling back the blockchain.
